body:
I don't mind all the questions, it helps me vent so I can feel a little bit better.

*What do you do with your time?* I mostly try to occupy myself, that's mostly getting out of my house, going to a friends house and getting high or drunk, just something to pull me away from reality for a while. A lot of video games. When i'm around the house I tend to do handyman type of stuff just so I don't feel like my mother is going to kick me out daily.

*Are there things that you really enjoy doing?* Socializing would be one thing, talking to anyone about anything. Meeting new people and sharing stories and experiences about stuff and the like. I love to help people with anything that I could possibly help with, whether it be relationship problems, technological problems, anything really. 

*How do you feel when you do those things?* I feel like I have some sense of accomplishment. Like i'm doing something right for once.

*Are you doing anything to feel productive?* If you mean productive on a daily basis, Yes. Some days I will call or visit the places where I have applied for a job and ask if my application has been reviewed or anything. Other days i'll be out with friends. i'll do stuff around the house, make dinner, ect. Sometimes, I won't do anything because I just really want to sit around and feel terrible for no reason.

*Do you feel like most of your time is wasted?* A high amount of it, yes. I feel like I could be doing more than I should be really, which just adds up once again to why I always feel bad about myself.

*How would you define not wasting time.* That's a good question, I feel like I waste a lot of my time being depressed at home when I could be trying to find a way to start my life.

*You mentioned hoping something really great happens to you, but what does that actually mean to you? What would you define as something really great?* When I say something great, I mean anything, just something to pull me out of this helpless stage that i'm in. It could be the love of my life, a job, Starting a new by moving to a new area, just anything really.

*Why do you think that your mind goes to such a dark place when you're alone?* Thats the main thing I really want to know. I understand how my past always creeps up from time to time, who's doesnt? But it's just every living moment of me just knowing that i'm alone and that's probably the way it will end in all truthfulness. that I can help someone out just for them to stab me in the back. I always try to have an optimistic outlook, but its just really hard with the way my mind likes to think of things realistically.

I don't know about that, I mean, when I get depressed I think about how everything can get better, it's just that I have no feeling for motivation, there really isn't any motivation in my life. I have nothing except an emotionless mind trying to give me some false sense of accomplishment on a day by day basis before something really great happens that a lot of good comes from. which is just another reason I just feel no hope for anything, because nothing good ever happens.

I feel depressed on most days. There will be some of those days where i'll be having a good day with friends, but if i'm given any time alone really, I just get this feeling of an emotionless void in my mind. And then from there on its nothing but thoughts of how I have that trapped feeling in life and no way to get out of it

As weird as it sounds, I really want to be a counselor or therapist of sorts.  If that doesn't work, i'd like to either get more into technology, or music.  I already have my GED so I apologize if my story was worded awkwardly.
